method: ENGINEERING native phone fixtures. Elevated floor, exact actor/camera poses, disabled AI and explicit relocation during held touch are arranged. Native taps/fire test physical results; direct synchronous calls instrument ray budget and weapon occlusion. Not ordinary missions or proof of every reviewer miss, human acquisition, frame rate or hardware performance.

checks.name: eight-pixel near miss selects a real surface without firing; later native FIRE uses normal physical damage
small movement during contact can be acquired but no ongoing tracking or large-jump prediction occurs
far misses and hidden, dead, invisible or beyond-range actors cannot attract the tap
nearer foreground cover blocks tolerance even when an adjacent probe could see the actor
HUD-covered origin and HUD-covered offset surfaces remain ineligible
visible weapon remains an absolute selection occluder
probe count is bounded under crowded misses; no target is selected past nearer cover
option disable and breacher selection retain native gesture semantics
